title: A must-do!
text: A magnificent place to discover with our guide Francesco who gave us a lot of information about Montserrat, but also about Barcelona. We were able to taste the cheeses from the market and had free time to visit at our own pace. Thank you very much!
author: Annie_La_81

title: Lovely Montserrat
text: It was really a marvellous experiences visiting the Montserrat with a our local guide Marta. She was awesome , very informative and has a great humour.  I recommend to book early especially in summer. The view of from the mountain is just unbelievably beautiful.
author: soniaMORA11
